title: Amazing Tours with Rutasur
text:
We had an absolutely amazing experience with Rutasur Andalusian Nature, taking two unforgettable day trips from Seville!

Our first trip was Ronda and the White Villages with Luis. The journey through Zahara de la Sierra, Setenil de las Bodegas, and Ronda was breathtaking. We loved wandering through the white-washed streets, seeing houses carved into rocks, and taking in the stunning landscapes of Andalusia. Ronda was the highlight, with its rich history and the famous New Bridge offering spectacular views. Luis was incredibly knowledgeable, friendly, and made the experience even more enjoyabl
author: CanadianEngineer007
